plan: Queue carry as primary. It is Mr_Meat31's best role at 53.4% over 121 games (overall is 52.9%). Set support as secondary, not the other way around.
Two-hero rule for the climb: Murdock and Phase. Compared with the average player on the same hero, Mr_Meat31 wins about 11.7 and 7.1 more games per 100 on them.
Mr_Meat31's champion pool is 7+ heroes wide and the top three are only 51% of the games. Gold-to-Platinum climbs are almost always pool-narrowing stories: aim for 70%+ of games on the top three.
Park Dekker for ranked: 40% over 63. Keep them for normals.
The math: Mr_Meat31 is at 935 VP; Platinum III starts at 900. The all-time peak is 935 — Platinum-level rating has been touched once already; this is a consistency problem, not a ceiling problem.
honesty: personal winrates are shrunk toward the player's own average (small heater samples do not count as mains)
field baselines are all-ranks aggregates from our current-patch match sample, not Gold-bracket-specific yet
winrate edges are observational; they say where the player wins, not why

insights.title: Mr_Meat31 is a closer, not a marathoner
insights.finding: Games under 28 minutes: 81%. Past 32: 50%. Press early leads and call objectives; do not let games drift.
insights.receipt: wins 17 of 21 short games vs 7 of 14 long ones, recent sample

insights.title: Mr_Meat31 is running hotter than the career line
insights.finding: The last 20 games are 75% against a 53% career. Whatever changed recently, keep it.

insights.title: The tilt tax is real for Mr_Meat31
insights.finding: Right after a loss Mr_Meat31 wins 53%; right after a win, 67%. One cooldown break after losses is free VP.
insights.receipt: 10/19 after losses vs 20/30 after wins, last 50 games

insights.title: For the group chat
